description: WSO2 Migrations skills: migrate Mirth Connect channel XML to compilable Ballerina integration projects.

interface.shortDescription: Migrate Mirth Connect channels to Ballerina integration projects.
interface.longDescription: Skill for migrating Mirth Connect channel XML into compilable Ballerina integration projects. Prioritizes HL7v2 MLLP/LLP listeners and TCP senders, and translates JavaScript transformers, filters, and channel-level scripts into idiomatic Ballerina code using the xlibb/pipeline module, generating typed stubs with full contract comments where the translation is ambiguous.
defaultPrompt: Migrate this Mirth Connect channel.xml to a Ballerina project.
How do I implement an HL7v2 MLLP listener in Ballerina?
Translate this Mirth JavaScript transformer to Ballerina.
